selection.basis: A00061 was independently consumed PASS by C00071/Q00003 and has not yet been converted to the active first-pass-v2 direct decoded-source/source-mask/CLEAN_PLATE contract. Current A00096/A00098 assets remain QA-pending and are skipped.

material_advance.description: Converts C-accepted A00061 reconstruction/mapping evidence into 22 exact-HD first-pass-v2 direct inspection work units. Known bindings are retained only as hypotheses to reconfirm from decoded source; three unresolved semantics remain fail-closed. Every region has a strict 2px upper-bound guard and deterministic RGBA32 row-scope template.

reused_immutable_evidence.reason: Q00003 accepted 8/8 current canonical semantics, 4/4 ENGLISH_SOURCE identities and 5/5 confirmed x4 mapped targets; those heavy checks are reused rather than repeated.

connector_binary_limit.reason: GitHub text connector exposes repository metadata/blob identities but rejects or omits non-UTF8 DDS binary bodies; no header or decoded-pixel PASS is fabricated.
connector_binary_limit.effect: Header confirmation and decoded source-effect masks remain required outputs of these executable work orders.
